name: com.energyaisolution/energyai
description: Free clean-energy tools: incentives, solar estimates, scores, guides, quotes, local installers.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OPTIONAL. Eight public tools need no key: check_incentives, estimate_production, get_node_score, get_quote_link, route_lead, list_guides, get_guide, and find_local_installers. Bearer <ENERGYAI_API_KEY> unlocks billed tools and preserves route_lead bounty attribution. Create and fund a key at https://api.energyaisolution.com/agents.
